references.observations: Bonanza L-plan and courtyard-parking forecourt, roofs and adjacency.
Pink/red Bonanza frontage, deep canopy on yellow slender posts, long white sign strip, circular sign at inner elbow.
Walgreens rounded corner, broad upper billboard band, pale ground level and pink vertical corner pier; two-level parking behind.
Paradise Road shops: low brick arcade and raised northern end; McDonalds cream/charcoal horizontal restaurant with yellow arches.

uncertainty: Current advertising creative and exact tenant storefront allocation unconfirmed. Existing roads/parking surfaces retained.
comparisons: Four initial and four final installed views inspected. Initial Bonanza round sign faced away; yaw corrected, lettering now readable. Walgreens sign added to shorter south edge.
Mapped L-shaped Bonanza, rounded Walgreens, garage slots and Paradise arcade implemented. Fine sign typography remains approximate; empty advertising band needs original finished graphic treatment.
Existing parking surfaces form long raised islands rather than photographed open parking forecourts; not altered in this building-only pass.
